NetworkEnhancer

Network-Level Tuning for Stable and Consistent Connectivity

NetworkEnhancer applies targeted network-level tuning to improve connection stability, reduce latency, and maintain consistent throughput across different network conditions.

--- ## Key Features `Stable Connectivity` — Improves connection consistency across networks `Reduced Latency` — Helps lower delay in online activities `Efficient Networking` — Optimizes background network behavior `Balanced Throughput` — Maintains stable data transfer performance --- ## Installation 1. Download the latest `.zip` from [Releases](https://github.com/RAAJK20Pro/NetworkEnhancer/releases) 2. Open Magisk or KernelSU 3. Go to Modules → Install from Storage 4. Select the zip file and reboot --- ## FAQ **Q: Works on Wi-Fi and mobile data?** A: Yes. It applies standard network tuning; results may vary by network and carrier. --- **Q: Can I use it with other network modules?** A: Not recommended — similar tweaks may conflict.
readmeHTML:
NetworkEnhancer

Network-Level Tuning for Stable and Consistent Connectivity

NetworkEnhancer applies targeted network-level tuning to improve connection stability, reduce latency, and maintain consistent throughput across different network conditions.

---

Key Features

Stable Connectivity — Improves connection consistency across networks

Reduced Latency — Helps lower delay in online activities

Efficient Networking — Optimizes background network behavior

Balanced Throughput — Maintains stable data transfer performance

---

Installation

  • Download the latest `.zip` from [Releases](https://github.com/RAAJK20Pro/NetworkEnhancer/releases)
  • Open Magisk or KernelSU
  • Go to Modules → Install from Storage
  • Select the zip file and reboot

    • ---

    FAQ

    Q: Works on Wi-Fi and mobile data?

    A: Yes. It applies standard network tuning; results may vary by network and carrier.

    ---

    Q: Can I use it with other network modules?

    A: Not recommended — similar tweaks may conflict.
